Klasse StepAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.StepAnalyzer
public class StepAnalyzer extends Object
Analyzes two different sequential game steps and provides information for the strategy and decision making.

Provides methods and attributes to compare information about the current and (if available) the previous GameModel.

The gathered information is analytical and be used by the strategy layer as a foundation for tactical and strategic decisions.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • StepAnalyzer

      public StepAnalyzer(GameModel previous, GameModel current)
      Constructs a new instance of a StepAnalyzer with the specified given parameters.

      Initializes all analytical attributes based on the given GameModel instances.

      Parameter:
      previous - GameModel or the previous step or null if first step
      current - the GameModel of the current step

  • Methodendetails

    • borderTypeNodes

      public List<Node> borderTypeNodes(List<Node> myNodes, List<Node> ring)
      Returns all nodes that are direct neighbors to enemy nodes.

      A node is considered a border node if the distance to the nearest enemy node on the ring is exactly 1.

      Parameter:
      myNodes - list of owned Nodes
      ring - list of Nodes forming the ring
      Gibt zurück:
      list of owned Nodes that are adjacent to enemy Nodes

    • inDangerNodes

      public List<Node> inDangerNodes(List<Node> myNodes, List<Node> ring)
      Returns all nodes that are threatened by enemy nodes.

      A node is considered in danger when the distance to the nearest enemy node on the ring is exactly <=2.

      Parameter:
      myNodes - list of owned Nodes
      ring - list of Nodes forming the ring
      Gibt zurück:
      list of owned Nodes that are adjacent to enemy Nodes

    • wholeRingVisible

      public boolean wholeRingVisible(GameModel gm)

      Parameter:

      Gibt zurück:
      true if no invisible Node was found

    • madeProgress

      public boolean madeProgress()
      Checks whether the agent made progress in the last step.

      Progress is defined as an increase in total Fernies AND nodes OR an increased ownership ratio combined with a decreased ownership of the enemy.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if the agent made progress

    • myFerniesComparator

      public int myFerniesComparator()
      Calculates the difference between the total number of Fernies owned by the agent in the previous and the current step.
      Gibt zurück:
      a positive value if the agent gained Fernies, zero if unchanged, and a negative value if the agent lost Fernies

    • myNodesComparator

      public int myNodesComparator()

    • visibleEnemiesComparator

      public int visibleEnemiesComparator()
      Calculates the difference between the number of visible enemy nodes in the previous and the current step.
      Gibt zurück:
      a positive value if more enemy Nodes are visible, zero if unchanged, and a negative value if fewer enemy nodes are visible

    • wasANeutralMove

      public boolean wasANeutralMove()
      Checks whether the last step can be considered mostly neutral.

      A move is considered as neutral if the ownership ratios, the nodes counts and visible enemy nodes did not changes significantly.
